content:
“You're healthy as a horse! Or deathclaw.”

**Natural Resistance** is an Endurance-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

It is exclusive to human players and cannot be equipped by ghoul players.

Grants cryo, fire, and poison resistance while not diseased, based on current Endurance.

| ![FO76 natural resistance perk bonus](https://static.wikia.nocookie.net/fallout/images/6/63/FO76_natural_resistance_perk_bonus.png) | | 
| | Endurance | Elemental Resistance | 
| | 1 | +10 | 
| | 15 | +35 | 
| | 30 | +55 | 
| | 60 | +75 | 
| | 100 | +100 | 

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | Increased Elemental Resistances based on END while not diseased. | 0018712E | 

Before update 56, Natural Resistance had 3 ranks that reduced environmental disease chance by 30%/60%/90%.

Other perks that scale with Endurance include:

- Adamantium Skeleton - Less limb damage
- Iron Stomach - Bonus damage and energy resistance
- Lead Belly - Less radiation from eating and drinking
- LifeGiver - Bonus HP
- Rad Resistant - Bonus radiation resistance
- Thirst Quencher - More AP
- Vaccinated - Higher disease resistance
